# `ceiling`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
ceiling(expr[, scale])
```

Returns the smallest number after rounding up that is not smaller than `expr`. An optional `scale` parameter can be specified to control the rounding behavior.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `math_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.3.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT ceiling(-0.1);
```

Result:

```text
0
```

```sql
SELECT ceiling(5);
```

Result:

```text
5
```

```sql
SELECT ceiling(3.1411, 3);
```

Result:

```text
3.142
```

```sql
SELECT ceiling(3.1411, -3);
```

Result:

```text
1000
```
